dedupe_keys.name: netsim grid simulation system for district heating cooling and steam networks vitec energy

description: NetSim is a grid simulation system from Vitec Energy, part of Vitec Software Group, for calculating pipe networks for district heating, district cooling and steam. The manual page read on 2026-09-26 says it dimensions pipe networks, optimises pumping and flow temperatures and minimises heat losses, with a graphical interface for defining networks, presentation of results as charts, diagrams and tables, export to Excel, DXF and DWG and raster formats, and import from network information systems. The product page adds pump placement and sizing, bottleneck detection, stagnation in summer operation, merging grids, the feasibility of new connections, and grid reactions to failures of the main power plant. Coverage is any utility network. Access is by commercial subscription with demos on request, and a university licence gives students all features with no annual fee, only a possible installation fee. Caveats: the vendor pages are promotional and give no prices or validation details, and models must be built from each utility's network data. Simulation uses are hydraulic and thermal network flow analysis, capacity planning of network extensions, and resilience checks of how a network responds when a main production plant fails. Related records: platform-neplan-network-analysis also models heating networks, and model-dhnx is an open tool for district heating network simulation.
